title: Animal 1
text: Title: Animal 1. The animal is cat. It has whiskers. It hunts mice. Secret code: CODE17.

title: Animal 2
text: Title: Animal 2. The animal is dog. It has bark. It guards houses. Secret code: CODE34.

title: Animal 3
text: Title: Animal 3. The animal is owl. It has night vision. It hunts at night. Secret code: CODE51.

title: Animal 4
